test+refactor: reach 100% line coverage post-merge (T-005)

Cover the post-merge misses introduced by the identity port +
cf wire-v2 work: identity-source plumbing (keyring/file/mem
kind/describe/error arms), cf vault config Debug + cred_for
error, ArcaHmac authenticate both sig arms, ops init/migrate/
open_cf_vault/load_required paths, and CLI Migrate mapping.

Env-dead lines (session keyring probe Ok arms, the keyring
migration print) are gated with cfg(coverage)/cfg(not(coverage))
declared via workspace lints — coverage/CI envs are headless.
Arc<dyn IdentitySource> + as_deref removes two dead closures.
